title: Sylo Code
subtitle: Carry on your Claude Code and Codex sessions from anywhere
description:
Connect Sylo to Claude Code or Codex on your computer and carry on any session from your phone or the web.

See every session and how it's going, read what it's done, reply, or start a new one in any folder. Sessions run exactly as they do in your terminal, with your own settings, tools and permissions.

reaches.why: To show what each is doing and read what it did.
To start a session in one you pick.

story.title: Run your AI sessions from your phone
